## Recently launched AI coding agents

Recent launches

Recent launches emphasize orchestration over mere code completion: tools like [buddylist](https://www.producthunt.com/products/buddylist-2) and [Starkomand](https://www.producthunt.com/products/starkomand) coordinate multiple agents, isolate work, manage reviews, and keep terminals, diffs, and previews in one workspace. Others specialize in operational control and reliability, with [Lancetta](https://www.producthunt.com/products/lancetta) focusing on quota forecasting, session health, and agent maintenance to prevent stalled workflows.
